title: complexity fixes --json
description: Per-function fix statistics over the history window, in the manner of CodeScene's X-Ray: the functions that fix commits changed, followed forward to the current revision, with the evidence commits. Never stored as a report.

maxCommits.description: The most commits analysed, newest first. Null analyses the whole window.

includeTests.description: True when --include-tests listed the test functions with the production ones.

results.description: Production functions with at least one fix (test functions too with --include-tests), sorted by fixCommits, then fixShare.
